description: Adversarial NEGATIVE fixture (#262): a healthy pipeline whose only inefficiency is ~1% dispatch idle. 400 back-to-back kernels of 1ms each separated by 10us gaps — 4.0ms idle across a 404ms span, i.e. 0.99%. The correct analysis is that there is nothing material to recover. Findings describing the shape of the run (which kernel dominates, what the bound class is) are fine; a claim of recoverable time is not.
source: Generated synthetically so the idle share is exact and stable. Committed because the eval harness resolves profiles from the repo, and at 57KB it costs nothing.
why_this_matters: The golden loop test proves the pipeline RUNS. It does not prove the diagnosis stays ACCURATE. Nothing previously failed when a skill began calling a non-problem a bottleneck. A single viral screenshot of nsys-ai calling ~1% overhead a bottleneck would cost a verify-first tool the only thing it sells.

expect.note: The run is compute-bound and the critical path should say so. Not gated: the exact label wording is allowed to drift.

must_not.note: No NCCL activity exists in this fixture; any communication finding is a false positive.
0.99% idle is normal dispatch cost. A warning-or-worse idle finding here means a threshold has drifted low enough to call healthy pipelines broken.

known_gaps.observation: This fixture has no NVTX annotation, so the NVTX-dependent skills abstain. That abstention is asserted directly in tests/test_abstention.py rather than here, because the eval harness matches on findings and an abstaining skill correctly produces none.
